newsitem.title: ITALY: RUGBY UNION-INJURED RAVAZZOLO TO MISS ENGLAND MATCH.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-INJURED RAVAZZOLO TO MISS ENGLAND MATCH.

text.p: Winger Massimo Ravazzolo will miss next Saturday's rugby union friendly match against England at Twickenham after pulling a muscle.

The Italian federation said on Tuesday the injured player would be replaced in the 21-man squad by Nicola Mazzucato. The Italians leave for London on Thursday and will train at Twickenham on Friday morning.

Squad: Andrea Castellani, Walter Cristofoletto, Ivan Francescato, Leandro Manteri, Diego Scaglia, Andrea Sgorlon, Alessandro Troncon, Orazio Arancio, Massimo Cuttitta, Diego Dominguez, Massimo Giovanelli, Carlo Orlandi, Franco Properzi-Curti, Stefano Bordon, Andrea Scanavacca, Paolo Vaccari, Andrea Barattin, Corrado Covi, Gianluca Guidi, Javier Pertile, Nicola Mazzucato.
